title: Digital lending: tell borrower the complaint escalation route
obligation: In digital lending, if a complaint is rejected wholly or partly, the borrower is not satisfied with the reply, or no reply is received within 30 days, the borrower can escalate to RBI's Complaint Management System under the Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, and the borrower must be told so.

source.document: Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025
quotes: or the borrower has not received any reply within 30 days of receipt of complaint by the RE, the said borrower can lodge a complaint over the Complaint Management System
This information shall be suitably conveyed to the borrower.

trigger_any: complaint rejected wholly or partly by the RE
borrower not satisfied with the reply
no reply within 30 days of receipt of complaint
must_convey: borrower can escalate on RBI's Complaint Management System (CMS) under the Integrated Ombudsman Scheme

notes: CORRECTION and NARROWING: the demo card generalised '30 days then Ombudsman' to every complaint. The primary text read here covers DIGITAL LENDING complaints (para 11(iv)). Other regimes (payments, banks, insurance, SEBI) have their own routes and timelines; do not reuse this number.
Whether the closing agent 'may not close without it' is NIYAM design, not in the quoted text. It is a test expectation, not a regulatory quote.
